QuestInfo.name: [Orange Mushroom] Endless Jumper
QuestInfo.0: You got nothing of use about the Mushking Empire, but you did hear about something new. Talk to #b#p9000292##k to meet the Endless Jumper.
QuestInfo.1: You got some new information from the Endless Jumper. Talk to #b#p9000292##k.
QuestInfo.2: You found out that they become a house if they don't jump. Time to investigate the mushroom houses of Henesys, then.
QuestInfo.rewardSummary: #Wbasic#\r\nCan proceed to [Orange Mushroom] Checking on Henesys\r\n

1.0: W-what?! How... B-but... This is too shocking to believe. You must be joking. You MUST be!
1.1: So if we don't jump... we become houses. This... is too much to take in. Then those houses in Henesys... I musn't stop jumping. Even in the bathroom.

yes.0: Well, at least it's not like we become nothing. I'll need to find a mushroom house in Henesys. Talk to me when you are ready. I need to rest... Sigh.

default.0: Not yet? If you #rwant to go to where the Jumping 'Shroom is, forfeit the quest#k and talk to me again.
